name: lambda:UpdateFunctionCode + lambda:AddPermission
description: Modify an existing Lambda function's code with malicious code and grant self-invocation permission via the resource-based policy to execute code under the function's privileged execution role
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have permission to update the target Lambda function's code
Must have permission to modify the target Lambda function's resource-based policy

additional.description: Helpful for discovering available Lambda functions to target
Useful for viewing function details including execution role ARN and resource policy
Useful for viewing function configuration details
Useful for viewing the function's resource-based policy
Useful for viewing the execution role's trust policy and permissions
Useful for understanding what permissions the execution role has

admin: A Lambda function must exist with an administrative execution role (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
lateral: A Lambda function must exist with a privileged execution role

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: FUNCTION_NAME
options.description: Target Lambda function name to update

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload type (exfil/response, exfil/https, backdoor/attach-policy, backdoor/create-role, backdoor/create-user)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Restore original function code and remove added permission after execution

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an existing IAM user or role

payloads.name: backdoor/create-access-key
payloads.description: Create new access keys for an existing IAM user (does not work on roles)

payloads.name: backdoor/create-role
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges and a custom trust policy

payloads.name: backdoor/create-user
payloads.description: Create an IAM user with administrator privileges and console access

payloads.name: backdoor/update-role-trust
payloads.description: Update a role's trust policy to add a trusted principal

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Send extracted credentials to a remote HTTPS endpoint

payloads.name: exfil/response
payloads.description: Extract credentials and return them in the Lambda function response

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate Lambda execution role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket

payloads.name: revshell/tls
payloads.description: Establish a TLS-encrypted reverse shell from inside a Lambda function. Only works with new-passrole modules where the function timeout can be set to 900s
